subject: S10 done: server-authoritative FSRS-6 cards, parity 3216/3216, db 334, e2e 24/24 x2, CI cards 36/36 chromium+firefox
body:
# S10 done — Flashcards with server-authoritative FSRS-6

**Commits on claude/naadi-shared (integrated cf8d618, gate --test-cmd green):** 0012 card_review_logs (down 0011) · cards API · /cards web · prod-CSP e2e + CI screens/10 · copy-scanner root + admin key count · Save as flashcard + Builder link · schema header.

## Tests
- Golden parity: packages/shared/fixtures/fsrs-golden.json, 390 cases / 3216 reviews (3 configs incl. fuzz; NY/London DST, Lord Howe 30-min shift, Chatham +12:45, St John's −3:30, Kolkata, local midnight): identical state/step/due ms/scheduled & elapsed days/reps/lapses/local due day in pytest (exact) and vitest (stability rel ≤1e-6). Seeded-fuzz RNG checked against JS values.
- Local on the integrated tree: db 334 passed (29 cards: graded-attempt gate incl. flag-only/ungraded/other-user attempts, service filter == RLS, hidden cards 404 on every endpoint, create from text/question/section, edit/delete own only, review logs, idempotent replay, concurrent retries apply once, out-of-order/too-old/future clamp, offline replay order, due ordering, stats across zones, retention/streak); unit 602; vitest 229; lint + typecheck clean; contracts/requirements no drift.
- e2e smoke (webkit iPad portrait/landscape, webkit phone 390, chromium 1440): 24/24 twice in a row with --retries=0.
- CI run 43975758547 (https://github.com/arrowassassin/naadi/actions/runs/43975758547), contains all S10 commits: db, lint/typecheck/unit/drift/build green; cards.spec 36/36 chromium and 36/36 firefox (6 tests × 6 viewports). Red jobs are not S10: chromium 19 = ink-sync.spec (S12b, 18) + qbank lab-values text (S08, 1); firefox 5 = agent.spec (1) + exam.spec (4). webkit job still running at posting; I'll add its result.

## Checklist (docs/REVIEW_CHECKLIST.md)
- Copy: every string is a cards.* ui_copy key (88, required list, shipped defaults regenerated); src/cards in noHardcodedCopy roots (passes). Server errors are codes (cards.error.<code>), never sentences.
- One lime per view (asserted in e2e by computed colour; progress fill is paper as in S08). Status words carry state (Question/Answer labels, rating words, Offline note).
- Phone 390/412 no truncation/overlap; content padded above the bottom bar.
- No dead buttons: New/Edit card disabled offline with the reason in the offline note; Stuck? panel absent unless features.assistant.
- Shortcuts ignore inputs, dialogs, ink pad, media, scroll regions; focused buttons keep Space (digits still rate). Tested.
- Leaks: question-linked shared cards hidden until a graded attempt through every endpoint, the cached due list and stats (db + e2e probe).
- Server-authoritative: card_reviews + card_review_logs SELECT-only for clients; RLS + coverage test + live_check (new check + mutations) in the same change; single alembic head 0012 (S11 chained 0013).
- Prod CSP: e2e on APP_ENV=prod with zero console errors (all engines in CI).
- No LLM calls in this segment.

## Screenshots
test-results/screens/10/ (CI artifact e2e-<browser>): empty, dialog-invalid, dialog-new, front, back, done, dialog-edit, dialog-delete, offline-pending, error, save-as-flashcard, builder-link — iPad portrait/landscape, phone 390, laptop 1440 locally; all 6 viewports × 3 engines in CI.

## Decisions
1. Server: official fsrs 6.3.3 (same FSRS-6 defaults, steps and floor fuzz as ts-fsrs 6.0.0); only change is a seeded fuzz (ts-fsrs's fnv1a+mulberry32, seed card_id+reps) so the preview equals the result.
2. Web: ts-fsrs 6.0.0 FSRS6Algorithm for all math, driven by the server's step policy. Stock ts-fsrs scheduling diverged from the official package on 89% of random sequences (UTC calendar vs 24-h days, monotonic clamp, Hard on later steps, 36500 stability cap).
3. Card scheduling tables are client SELECT-only (like ink 0009); deleting a card or the account cascades.
4. Card faces: plain text → TipTap doc (front_doc/back_doc) for ContentRenderer; html kept as interchange.
5. /cards route as briefed; the board puts Cards under Practice, so the Practice tab is not highlighted on /cards (shell matches by path) — small shell follow-up if wanted.
6. Fuzz off by default (ts-fsrs default); admins can switch it on in app_config.fsrs.
7. Offline: due list cached per user; ratings queued in localStorage outbox with client_review_id, replayed in order (S18 takes over by the same body).
Pending on others: mount S12b's useInkLayer('flashcard', id) + InkSaveStatus once apps/web/src/ink/persist lands; Stuck? buttons dispatch `naadi:assistant-ask` for S14.
